objective: Run 3 per-level SPEEDRUN specialist on Jungle2: continuation fine-tune from the BEST CHECKPOINT of predecessor run macro-ppo-jungle2 (s99081684) with the score-shaping cap realigned from 10.0 to 1.0. stall_evidence.freeze_addendum: MISALIGNMENT EVIDENCE - the predecessor's terminal signature is NOT the Jungle1 stall: final training_status.json (sha256:89cfc4a035c2b13aac12d888e0e8d1059189ea10003669d8624bee05897f08b4): timesteps 10,004,480; episodes 9,174; wins 32 and STILL ACCRUING at the end of the budget (checkpoint-wise counts observed live: 16 at ~3.2k episodes, 18 at ~4.1k, 21 at ~6k, 24 at ~7k, 27 at ~8k, 29 at ~9k, final 32 at 9,174; only the endpoint is derivable from on-disk artifacts - curriculum_history.jsonl holds only the training_start/training_end rows (wins {} -> {Jungle2: 32}) and tensorboard has no win-count scalar - and of the intermediates only the 16 -> 18 segment is independently on disk, in this draft's own verbatim prose); losses 1,491; truncations 7,651 (83% of episodes farm to the 12,000-tick training horizon); observed_win_rate ~0.0035; recent_win_rate 0.0 over the final 64 episodes (consistent with a ~0.35% win rate, not a terminal stall). Meanwhile the DETERMINISTIC argmax policy converted none of 17 evals (0/1 at eval-ckpt1M..9M, 0/8 on the final 8-seed eval). Stochastic wins that keep accruing while the deterministic policy never converts is reward misalignment by ADVANTAGE DILUTION (deterministic-policy sharpening failure) rather than exploration collapse: under score_progress_reward_cap 10.0 the abundant score-farming returns rival the rare win returns and drown the advantage signal that would sharpen winning trajectories into the argmax mode; the cap realignment to 1.0 (trainer_v2.reward_alignment) is exactly the fix this run tests.

clause_2_reward_misalignment.clause: if two consecutive checkpoints show zero new TRAINING wins in the run's training_status.json while eval score rises, the run is stopped as reward-misaligned
clause_2_reward_misalignment.rationale: this is the lesson of the predecessor generation's stall (Jungle1 training wins frozen at 16 over 1,700+ episodes; Jungle2 trickling 16 -> 18, both while firing 36-40 shots/episode and farming score): a policy that gets better at scoring without winning is optimizing the shaping, not the objective. trainer_v2.reward_alignment: cap lowered 10.0 -> 1.0 (the ONLY reward delta from the predecessor). SPEEDRUN objective: score shaping is a discovery aid only and must never rival the +10 win bonus. Under the predecessor's cap of 10.0, a shaped truncation return could approach a win's return, and the predecessor generation duly farmed score without finishing (Jungle1 wins frozen at 16; Jungle2 trickling 16 -> 18 over 1,700+ episodes). Under 1.0, the max shaped truncation return is ~= 1.0 minus the time penalty, far below the worst-case win return of ~= 8.6 (win +10, plus at most +1.0 shaping, minus 24000 ticks x 0.0001 time penalty = 2.4), so finishing strictly dominates farming everywhere in return space.
trainer_v2.discounting_note: gamma applies PER MACRO STEP; the macro reward is the undiscounted per-tick sum over the ticks the macro consumed (~20-70), so 0.999 per macro is roughly 0.999^(1/40) per native tick; truncation is reward-neutral (v2 wrapper), so 24000-tick late-level truncations bootstrap instead of paying -10

success_criteria_tiers.scope_note: all tiers are STUDENT_ONLY autonomous outcomes on engineering-seed evals of Jungle2; teacher-assisted or recovery-mode wins count for nothing here. SPEEDRUN objective: success is win rate first, then median winning ticks; SCORE IS EXPLICITLY NOT A SUCCESS METRIC at any tier (it appears in telemetry only as a liveness diagnostic)
success_criteria_tiers.tier_0_sanity: wrapper fidelity holds under the trained policy: shots_on_target_rate >= 0.95 on every eval, and the policy fires at >= 0.5x the teacher's macro fire rate (the BC init fires ~20x too rarely; PPO must at least not collapse further)
success_criteria_tiers.tier_1_signal: any autonomous Jungle2 win at any checkpoint
success_criteria_tiers.tier_2_promising: win rate >= 50% over the 8-seed Jungle2 eval of the best checkpoint
success_criteria_tiers.tier_3_strong: median winning ticks over the 8-seed eval of the best checkpoint <= 1.5x the teacher-through-macro Jungle2 time: 55-level teacher ceiling map teacher55 (s99081681) won Jungle2 in 2300 native ticks (completion sha256:a35dd7e1cd182b0d59ce69a6ef4d91f6310511735d0da5d5b9d7e068b24f9d20), so the threshold is 3450 ticks

teacher_reference.threshold_rule: tier_3 threshold = floor(1.5 x teacher ticks)

success_criteria_tiers.failure_is_reportable: if tier 1 is not reached, the run is reported as FAIL with the full eval telemetry; no re-slicing after the fact
